PHASE 04 / DECIDE

Prove the economics

How will it make money, qualify for opportunities, support your country and expand?

Start this phase
WHAT YOU WILL HAVE AT THE ENDA practical unit-economics sheet, grant-fit evidence and an expansion decision.BEFORE YOU MOVE FORWARD

Price exceeds variable costs, capacity and cash needs are realistic, and at least one acquisition path can plausibly work.

THE ACTION PLAN

Do these 4 things.

0 / 4 complete
01
45–90 min · Before committing to full build, advertising spend or hiring.

Calculate how money actually comes in

Know what you keep from each sale and how many sales you need.

Open step 02
45 min · After the business model is defined; before grant applications.

Connect the offer to a genuine development priority

Identify credible national or regional impact, without forcing a false impact story.

Open step 03
30–60 min initially; revisit weekly · Once you can explain use of funds, eligibility and delivery milestones.

Find grants, accelerators and capital pathways

Find suitable support, not just attractive grant headlines.

Open step 04
45 min · Before promising a regional footprint or investing in multi-country infrastructure.

Ask whether this can grow past the first island

Differentiate a repeatable profitable model from an expensive expansion idea.

Open step
Gate to move forward

Price exceeds variable costs, capacity and cash needs are realistic, and at least one acquisition path can plausibly work.
